_doc: Lint hits scripts/lint-scan.py accepts on shipped dashboards (#1133): per code, the file globs it may fire on and why. A new code firing on a shipped dashboard fails the scan: fix the false positive, fix the dashboard, or add it here with the reason.

folder/setup-table.why: Browser examples and site pages: each page runs in its own DuckDB-Wasm, so the served-memory cost this warns about doesn't apply.

layout/input-scope.why: The cost inputs sit on the Decision tab on purpose: there you set the costs, and the plan shown on the other tabs follows.

layout/mixed-input-row.why: The delivery picker and the two check thresholds stay together in the filter bar, although the price-move threshold only changes the Volume & prices tab.

input/unused.why: The variable is read by sel_sector(), a macro init.sql defines in the served database; the lint reads the dashboard's text only (the browser's Check has no database), and its note says so.

design/untitled-chart.why: The feature gallery shows bare chart kinds; sessions.sql is the minimal serve demo.

design/too-many-panels.why: The feature gallery is one long page of tiles on purpose; m5_analytics is a serve demo of one comparison.

design/ungrouped-kpis.why: The KPI gallery shows bare tiles; ops.sql is the load-test reference page, kept as measured.

design/unsorted-bars.why: Bars in a fixed category order, not a ranking: channels, and model terms that must line up across the facets.
